conditions: CLEARING-AT-END OR NOT IS-FILE-HEADER OR FH-FILE-DATE NOT = WS-RUN-DATE
actions: OPEN INPUT CLEARING-IN OUTPUT PRES-OUT REJECT-OUT REPORT-OUT
PERFORM TAKE-BATCH UNTIL CLEARING-AT-END OR IS-FILE-TRAILER OR IO-FAILED

rules.sentence: When `WS-IO-FAILED` is `'Y'` (`IO-FAILED`), it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `CLEARING-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`); `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'FH'` (not `IS-FILE-HEADER`), or `FH-FILE-DATE` is not `WS-RUN-DATE`; and `WS-IO-FAILED` is `'Y'` (`IO-FAILED`), tested again, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `CLEARING-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-CLEARING`; sets `WS-RESULT` to 12; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `CLEARING-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; sets `WS-RESULT` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`); `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'FH'` (not `IS-FILE-HEADER`), or `FH-FILE-DATE` is not `WS-RUN-DATE`; and `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`), tested again, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `CLEARING-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-CLEARING`; sets `WS-RESULT` to 12; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `CLEARING-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

When `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`); `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is not `'10'` (not `CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'FH'` (`IS-FILE-HEADER`), and `FH-FILE-DATE` is `WS-RUN-DATE`; and `WS-IO-FAILED` is `'Y'` (`IO-FAILED`), tested again, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `CLEARING-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `TAKE-BATCH` until `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'FT'` (`IS-FILE-TRAILER`), or `WS-IO-FAILED` is `'Y'` (`IO-FAILED`); performs `CHECK-FILE-TRAILER`; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `CLEARING-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; sets `WS-RESULT` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`); `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is not `'10'` (not `CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'FH'` (`IS-FILE-HEADER`), and `FH-FILE-DATE` is `WS-RUN-DATE`; and `WS-IO-FAILED` is not `'Y'` (not `IO-FAILED`), tested again, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `CLEARING-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `TAKE-BATCH` until `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`), `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'FT'` (`IS-FILE-TRAILER`), or `WS-IO-FAILED` is `'Y'` (`IO-FAILED`); performs `CHECK-FILE-TRAILER`; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `CLEARING-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.
When reading `CLEARING-IN` finds no more records, it reads `CLEARING-IN` and sets `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` to `CLEARING-AT-END`.
When reading `CLEARING-IN` finds a record, it reads `CLEARING-IN`.

conditions: IS-BATCH-TRAILER AND BT-COUNT = WS-BATCH-COUNT AND BT-AMOUNT = WS-BATCH-AMOUNT
actions: MOVE ZERO TO WS-BATCH-COUNT WS-BATCH-AMOUNT WS-HELD-COUNT
PERFORM TAKE-PRESENTMENT UNTIL CLEARING-AT-END OR NOT IS-PRESENTMENT

rules.sentence: When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'BH'` (not `IS-BATCH-HEADER`), it sets `WS-REASON` to `'ORDR'`, performs `REJECT-RECORD`, performs `READ-CLEARING`, and leaves the section.

When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BH'` (`IS-BATCH-HEADER`); `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BT'` (`IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), `BT-COUNT` is `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, and `BT-AMOUNT` is `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`; and `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BT'` (`IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), it sets `WS-BATCH-NO` to `BH-BATCH-NO`; sets `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`, and `WS-HELD-COUNT` to zero; adds 1 to `WS-BATCHES`; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `TAKE-PRESENTMENT` until `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`) or `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'PR'` (not `IS-PRESENTMENT`); sets `WS-RECORD-READ` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`; performs `RELEASE-BATCH`; sets `CLR-PRESENTMENT` to `WS-RECORD-READ`; and performs `READ-CLEARING`.

When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BH'` (`IS-BATCH-HEADER`); `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'BT'` (not `IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), `BT-COUNT` is not `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, or `BT-AMOUNT` is not `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`; and `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BT'` (`IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), it sets `WS-BATCH-NO` to `BH-BATCH-NO`; sets `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`, and `WS-HELD-COUNT` to zero; adds 1 to `WS-BATCHES`; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `TAKE-PRESENTMENT` until `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`) or `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'PR'` (not `IS-PRESENTMENT`); sets `WS-RECORD-READ` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`; performs `REJECT-BATCH`; sets `CLR-PRESENTMENT` to `WS-RECORD-READ`; and performs `READ-CLEARING`.

When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'BH'` (`IS-BATCH-HEADER`); `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'BT'` (not `IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), `BT-COUNT` is not `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, or `BT-AMOUNT` is not `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`; and `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'BT'` (not `IS-BATCH-TRAILER`), it sets `WS-BATCH-NO` to `BH-BATCH-NO`; sets `WS-BATCH-COUNT`, `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT`, and `WS-HELD-COUNT` to zero; adds 1 to `WS-BATCHES`; performs `READ-CLEARING`; performs `TAKE-PRESENTMENT` until `WS-CLEARING-STATUS` is `'10'` (`CLEARING-AT-END`) or `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'PR'` (not `IS-PRESENTMENT`); sets `WS-RECORD-READ` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`; performs `REJECT-BATCH`; and sets `CLR-PRESENTMENT` to `WS-RECORD-READ`.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`PRESENTMENT-IS-GOOD`) and `WS-HELD-COUNT` is less than `MAX-BATCH`, it adds 1 to `WS-BATCH-COUNT` and `WS-RECORDS`; adds `PR-AMOUNT` to `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT` and `WS-AMOUNT`; performs `VALIDATE-PRESENTMENT`; adds 1 to `WS-HELD-COUNT`; sets `WS-HELD-PRESENTMENT(WS-HELD-COUNT)` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`; and performs `READ-CLEARING`.

When `WS-REASON` is not spaces (not `PRESENTMENT-IS-GOOD`) or `WS-HELD-COUNT` is at least `MAX-BATCH`, it adds 1 to `WS-BATCH-COUNT` and `WS-RECORDS`; adds `PR-AMOUNT` to `WS-BATCH-AMOUNT` and `WS-AMOUNT`; performs `VALIDATE-PRESENTMENT`; performs `REJECT-RECORD`; and performs `READ-CLEARING`.

conditions: PR-PRODUCT NOT = 'CL' AND PR-PRODUCT NOT = 'GD' AND PR-PRODUCT NOT = 'BZ'

rules.sentence: When `PR-CARD-NO` is not numeric, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'CARD'`.
When `PR-CARD-NO` is numeric and `PR-AMOUNT` is at most zero, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'AMNT'`.
When `PR-CARD-NO` is numeric, `PR-AMOUNT` is more than zero, and `PR-MCC` is not numeric, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'MCC '`.
When `PR-CARD-NO` is numeric; `PR-AMOUNT` is more than zero; `PR-MCC` is numeric; and `PR-REGION` is not `'D'` and `PR-REGION` is not `'I'`, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'REGN'`.

When `PR-CARD-NO` is numeric; `PR-AMOUNT` is more than zero; `PR-MCC` is numeric; `PR-REGION` is `'D'` or `PR-REGION` is `'I'`; and `PR-PRODUCT` is not `'CL'`, `PR-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'`, and `PR-PRODUCT` is not `'BZ'`, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'PROD'`.

When `PR-CARD-NO` is numeric; `PR-AMOUNT` is more than zero; `PR-MCC` is numeric; `PR-REGION` is `'D'` or `PR-REGION` is `'I'`; and `PR-PRODUCT` is `'CL'`, `PR-PRODUCT` is `'GD'`, or `PR-PRODUCT` is `'BZ'`, it sets `WS-REASON` to spaces.

When `WS-RESULT` is less than 4, it sets `REJECT-LINE` to spaces, sets `RJ-REASON` to `WS-REASON`, sets `RJ-BATCH-NO` to `WS-BATCH-NO`, sets `RJ-RECORD` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`, writes `REJECT-LINE`, adds 1 to `WS-REJECTED`, and sets `WS-RESULT` to 4.

When `WS-RESULT` is at least 4, it sets `REJECT-LINE` to spaces, sets `RJ-REASON` to `WS-REASON`, sets `RJ-BATCH-NO` to `WS-BATCH-NO`, sets `RJ-RECORD` to `CLR-PRESENTMENT`, writes `REJECT-LINE`, and adds 1 to `WS-REJECTED`.

conditions: NOT IS-FILE-TRAILER OR FT-BATCH-COUNT NOT = WS-BATCHES OR FT-RECORD-COUNT NOT = WS-RECORDS OR FT-AMOUNT NOT = WS-AMOUNT

rules.sentence: When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is not `'FT'` (not `IS-FILE-TRAILER`), `FT-BATCH-COUNT` is not `WS-BATCHES`, `FT-RECORD-COUNT` is not `WS-RECORDS`, or `FT-AMOUNT` is not `WS-AMOUNT`, it sets `WS-RESULT` to 8.
When `CLR-RECORD-TYPE` is `'FT'` (`IS-FILE-TRAILER`), `FT-BATCH-COUNT` is `WS-BATCHES`, `FT-RECORD-COUNT` is `WS-RECORDS`, and `FT-AMOUNT` is `WS-AMOUNT`, it does nothing more.
